definition: Tentative means not final or definite; subject to change.
task: Write one sentence of your own using the word tentative. Make the sentence show what the word means -- a reader who did not know tentative should be able to work it out from your sentence.
avoid_verbatim: Rehearsals follow a tentative schedule until the theater confirms which nights the main stage is free.
A floated idea is merely tossed into the room to see faces; tentative goes further - an actual arrangement exists, just one that can still move.
Official outranks tentative: a tentative date can slide quietly, but an official one is announced, binding, and printed on the tickets.

Unconfirmed hangs on someone else's answer: a booking, a report, or a rumor stays unconfirmed while you wait for another party to say a final yes. Tentative describes the plan's own status — a real arrangement exists, but its makers have deliberately left it open to change.

Changeable describes a standing disposition to shift — weather, moods, prices that move for any reason at all, over and over. Tentative marks a one-time status instead: this particular plan is real but not yet final, and it stops being tentative the moment it locks.
